env TZ=UTC
at 2026-08-05T12:00:00Z
mkdir source destination

# Reserve the first catalog identities so restored destination records remain
# disjoint from the selected source board.
exec card --store $WORK/source init --no-config --prefix reserve- --board-name Reserve
exec card --store $WORK/source config set --scope store issue.id.strategy sequential
exec card --store $WORK/source --json project create Engineering --prefix eng-
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/engineering-project.json
exec card --store $WORK/source --json board create --project project_11111111111111111111 Primary
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/primary-board.json

# The default backup selection carries issue state and attachment content.
exec card --store $WORK/source --board Primary create --priority 1 --summary 'Primary shield calibration.' 'Calibrate shields'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/primary-issue-id.txt
exec card --store $WORK/source --board Primary --json attachment add report.txt --issue eng-1
cp stdout $WORK/attachment.json
exec jq -r .id $WORK/attachment.json
cp stdout $WORK/attachment-id.txt
exec card --json --store $WORK/source --board Primary backup $WORK/selected.cardamom
cmpenv stdout $WORK/golden/selected-backup.json

# Restore into a non-empty store and retain its unrelated catalog and issue.
exec card --store $WORK/destination init --no-config --prefix dest- --board-name Existing
exec card --store $WORK/destination config set --scope store issue.id.strategy sequential
exec card --store $WORK/destination --board Existing create --summary 'Destination-only record.' 'Keep local issue'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/destination-issue-id.txt
exec card --json --store $WORK/destination restore $WORK/selected.cardamom
cmpenv stdout $WORK/golden/first-restore.json

exec card --store $WORK/destination --json project list
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/destination-projects.jsonl
cp stdout $WORK/destination-projects.jsonl
exec card --store $WORK/destination --json board list
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/destination-boards.jsonl
cp stdout $WORK/destination-boards.jsonl

exec card --store $WORK/destination --board Existing --json show dest-1
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/destination-issue.json
exec card --store $WORK/destination --board Primary --json show eng-1
cp stdout $WORK/primary-issue.json
exec jq -c 'del(.revision, .attachments[0].id, .attachments[0].created.revision)' $WORK/primary-issue.json
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/primary-issue.json
exec card --store $WORK/destination --board Primary search calibration
stdout '^1 match$'
stdout 'eng-1 +ready +summary'

exec sh -c 'card --store "$1" --board Primary attachment get "$(cat "$2")" restored-report.txt' get-restored $WORK/destination $WORK/attachment-id.txt
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/attachment-get.txt
cmp restored-report.txt $WORK/report.txt

exec card --store $WORK/destination --board Existing --json list
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/destination-issues.jsonl
cp stdout $WORK/destination-issues.jsonl
exec card --store $WORK/destination --board Primary --json list
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/primary-issues.jsonl
cp stdout $WORK/primary-issues.jsonl

# Reapplying the archive reports completion without changing public records.
exec card --json --store $WORK/destination restore $WORK/selected.cardamom
cmpenv stdout $WORK/golden/repeated-restore.json
exec card --store $WORK/destination --json project list
cmp stdout $WORK/destination-projects.jsonl
exec card --store $WORK/destination --json board list
cmp stdout $WORK/destination-boards.jsonl
exec card --store $WORK/destination --board Existing --json list
cmp stdout $WORK/destination-issues.jsonl
exec card --store $WORK/destination --board Primary --json list
cmp stdout $WORK/primary-issues.jsonl

-- report.txt --
sensor calibration report
phase=complete
